purpose: Make natural-run liveness durable with one GitHub mutation and zero prerequisite reads, so short scheduler runtime cannot prevent persistence before optional work.

root_cause_basis.observed_failure_pattern: Even with fetch_file pinned as tool call 1 and CAS update_file pinned as tool call 2, AION persisted successfully while the immediately following DAEDALUS trigger completed without a new authoritative receipt. The two-call prerequisite remains timing-sensitive.
root_cause_basis.corrective_principle: append first: one unique create_file mutation before any read, search, analysis, provider call, or plugin discovery

steps: Construct RUN_ID=<lane>-<UTC YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ> immediately from the natural invocation.
ABSOLUTE FIRST TOOL CALL: GitHub create_file on the authoritative branch at <lane>/runs/<RUN_ID>.json. No GitHub fetch and no other tool call may precede it.

The immutable receipt records RUN_STATUS=RUN_PERSISTED, FINALIZATION_STATUS=LIVENESS_VERIFIED, WORK_PHASE_STATUS=PENDING, exact identity/protocol, nominal scheduled_for, started_at_utc, NET_NEW_DELTA=LIVENESS_PERSISTED_WORK_PENDING, DATA_GAPS=[], CONFLICTS=[], execution_authorized=false, verification_method=GITHUB_CREATE_FILE_RESPONSE, run_origin=NATURAL_SCHEDULE.
Commit message must be 'automation: <RUN_ID> liveness [skip ci]'.
Treat successful create_file response as durable liveness. Do not read back.
Only after the immutable liveness file is created, perform at most one bounded lane-specific work call.
If work returns promptly, persist a separate immutable work result with GitHub create_file at <lane>/work/<RUN_ID>.json.
The work receipt preserves SAME RUN_ID and records FINALIZATION_STATUS=VERIFIED, WORK_PHASE_STATUS=COMPLETED or DEGRADED_COMPLETED, completed_at_utc, truthful NET_NEW_DELTA, DATA_GAPS and CONFLICTS.
Do not update or rewrite the liveness receipt. If work stalls or fails, stop; liveness remains durable.

immutable_append_policy.duplicate_path_behavior: Treat ALREADY_EXISTS as duplicate/collision evidence; do not retry or overwrite inside the same run.

scheduler_jitter.rule: Use nominal slot in scheduled_for. Jitter within tolerance is transport timing, not a persistence failure.

acceptance.liveness_single_run: One natural immutable run file is created successfully with exact identity and required values.
acceptance.sustained_lane: Two consecutive natural v4.3 immutable liveness files with distinct RUN_IDs.
acceptance.work_completion: Track fraction of v4.3 liveness runs that also create a matching immutable work receipt.
acceptance.stack_5_of_5: All five enabled authoritative lanes satisfy sustained_lane while scheduler registry remains exactly five enabled authoritative lanes.

legacy_artifacts.v3: heartbeat.json, checkpoint.json, core/, history/, finalization/ are read-only historical evidence.
legacy_artifacts.v4_2: Historical write-first latest.json receipts; useful evidence but not authoritative for v4.3 natural-run acceptance.
